speaker: margery_pell
text: Lawyers saying farewell to their laundresses. Twenty-six shillings in mine, and I'll not see a black gown till Michaelmas.

speaker: will_sly
text: You are dead, Master Shakespeare. Dead by the fourth act, and standing in the door as if a dead Roman had business.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: The business is tomorrow. The book has lain at Clerkenwell since Monday.

speaker: will_sly
text: The Admiral's men are in Kent by now, or else the west. Nobody over the water can say which. I am not picking a shire for them.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Then neither am I. Kent was the tiring-house guess on Monday. It is still a guess.

speaker: margery_pell
text: The mules are at this end of Shoreditch with the lawyers' trunks. I saw them from the stair. I am not walking back to noon to count them.

speaker: will_sly
text: Gowns going out to country air. By the week's end they will be in every shire, telling June over supper, and the supper will improve it.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: That supper is not this week. Tomorrow at ten. That is the only hour I am keeping.

speaker: margery_pell
text: Twenty-six is my stair, not your purse. Do not go home and write it as if you had gathered it.

speaker: will_sly
text: And do not go home and write me a shire. I said Kent or the west. I did not marry them.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: No shire. Ten in the morning, at St John's. John is in it. I am in it. The yard is not.

speaker: margery_pell
text: Then get off my stair. The gowns are done, and a dead man blocks a paying one.

speaker: will_sly
text: Off the stair. I will tell the hired men you died on time. It is the best notice I have.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: On time, and not in the fifth. I am going by the street. The book can wait where it has waited since Monday.

speaker: margery_pell
text: Michaelmas. That is when the black gowns come back. Until then my twenty-six is a memory with a lock on it.

speaker: will_sly
text: Trinity term ends. The almanac said so this morning. The vacation can have the lawyers. We still have a Thursday.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Thursday at ten. I have said it twice so I do not say it at home as if it were news from a second messenger.

speaker: margery_pell
text: Twice is enough. A third time and I charge you for the echo.

speaker: will_sly
text: No echo. Kent or the west, and the door is a door, not a map.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: The old Roman is done for the day. The living man has a morning.

speaker: margery_pell
text: Living men pay at the stair if they come back in. You are going out. Go.

speaker: will_sly
text: I played against you while you were alive. I will not invent a fifth act on the step.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: No fifth. The mules can take the trunks. I am not following them.

speaker: margery_pell
text: Good. The country air is theirs. My lock is mine. Twenty-six stays in it.

speaker: will_sly
text: And tomorrow is ten, not two. I can remember an hour if it is not mine.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Ten, not two. John knows. I am done with the door.
